Game Overview

In Old Man and Demon, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a perilous journey through hell's dark underworld to save your friend. Navigate eerie tunnels with only a lantern, dodge deadly traps, and face monstrous foes. Can you brave the darkness and confront Satan himself? Your courage and decisions will determine the outcome.
